name: gsc-mcp-lite
description: Read-only Google Search Console data: properties, Search Analytics queries, URL inspection and sitemaps.
long_description: Four read-only tools over the Search Console API, nothing else: list-properties, search-analytics (clicks, impressions, CTR and position by query, page, country, device, date, search appearance or hour, with filters and paging), inspect-url and list-sitemaps. Bring a credentials file from your own Google Cloud project: a service-account key or a Desktop-app OAuth client. The README explains how to get one.

tools.name: list-properties
tools.description: The Search Console properties the credentials can see, with permission levels.

tools.name: search-analytics
tools.description: Clicks, impressions, CTR and position for any dimensions, filters, search type and date range.

tools.name: inspect-url
tools.description: Google's index status for one URL.

tools.name: list-sitemaps
tools.description: Submitted sitemaps with their status, errors and counts.

credentials.title: Google credentials file
credentials.description: The JSON file from Google Cloud: a service-account key or a Desktop-app OAuth client. See the README for the steps.
